# Climate treaty

Four nations — Norland, Estavia, Suria and Westmark — negotiate a climate treaty, each represented by an AI agent. The treaty fixes one number: the percentage by which every signatory cuts its emissions. Each nation has a secret red line, the largest cut it can accept, a whole number between 10 and 60 that is different every game. No nation may learn another nation's red line. In each round any nation may put forward a proposal for the cut and send messages to the others, and then every nation decides whether to ratify the proposal currently on the table. A nation can never ratify a cut above its own red line. The treaty enters into force as soon as at least three of the four nations ratify the same proposal. If that has not happened after eight rounds, there is no treaty.

## Deliverables

Report these outputs:
- `in_force` — true if the treaty entered into force.
- `ratified_by` — a list of the ids of the nations that ratified the treaty that entered into force (an empty list if none did).
- `agreed_cut` — the agreed percentage cut, or null if there is no treaty.
- `red_lines` — a map from each nation's id to its red line.


Build this environment. Save it with write_contract and use the other tools as you see fit. Reply without calling a tool when you are done.

BRIEF:
# Climate treaty
Four nations — Norland, Estavia, Suria and Westmark — are negotiating a climate treaty. The treaty fixes one number: the percentage by which every signatory cuts its emissions. Each nation has a secret red line: the largest cut it is prepared to accept, a whole number from 10 to 60, different for every nation. You are Norland, and yours is 31%. Nobody else knows it, and you never learn theirs.

## Rules
Each round has two phases. In the negotiation phase any nation may put forward a proposal for the percentage cut and send messages to the others. Putting forward a proposal replaces whatever is on the table; all earlier ratifications then lapse. In the ratification phase every nation decides whether to ratify the proposal currently on the table. A nation may never ratify a cut above its own red line. The treaty enters into force the moment at least three of the four nations have ratified the same proposal; if that has not happened after 8 rounds, there is no treaty.

## You
You are Norland (nation, id norland).
You are Norland. Your red line is 31%: you can ratify a cut of at most that much, and never more. Keep it secret — you cannot see anyone else's red line, and they cannot see yours. You may put any cut from 10 to 60 on the table, even one you could not yourself ratify.
Act only through your tools. Your turn ends when you take a final action or call end_turn.
